name: han-communication
description: Foundational communication plugin for the Han suite. Owns the canonical readability standard, the writing-voice profile, and the explanation standard for talking to a reader who will not implement the work, plus the readability-guidance skill that surfaces the first two into a calling skill's own context for in-voice drafting, the explanation-guidance skill that surfaces the third at the point a run talks to a person, the readability-editor agent that runs the adversarial rewrite over a finished draft, and the edit-for-readability skill that applies that rewrite on demand. Depends on nothing and sits beneath every other plugin; the plugins that produce prose output depend on it.
